Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
I'd like to make an appointment.
You can book an appointment through the online reservation form on our website. Alternatively, I can have a staff member call you back to arrange it. Would you like to do that?
Great choice! If you need any help with that or have questions later, feel free to ask. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
